content.short: Mine Bitcoin with EMCD's pool and its daily payouts, then save, trade P2P or hold coins in the same app.
content.description: EMCD started as a mining pool and is still one of the larger Bitcoin pools by hashrate, paying miners out every day with transparent fees. Around the pool it has built a custodial multi-currency wallet for BTC, ETH, USDT, DOGE and other coins, and a P2P marketplace for buying and selling with local payment methods. Its Coinhold savings product pays interest on deposits. The pool has ranked in the global top ten since 2017 and offers its own firmware and monitoring tools for miners, while its P2P service lets users buy and sell crypto without fees.
content.meta: Bitcoin mining pool with daily payouts, a multi-coin wallet, savings and P2P trading in one app. Explore EMCD on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
